candidates.angle: The word shreshtha, the best, sets the standard for everyone else.
The world follows whatever standard the best person sets.
The word anuvartate, to follow, shows that people copy exactly.

angle_en: Shreshtha sets the standard for everyone
angle_hi: श्रेष्ठ शब्द ही मानक तय करता है

en.intro: Krishna continues by explaining why Arjuna must act, reminding him that his conduct is watched by the world.
en.notice: The word shreshtha, the best, is the key here. It is not about being the strongest, but about being the most respected, and your example becomes the standard that everyone else copies.
en.next: Krishna then asks Partha how the world would be led if he, the best, were to stop working.
en.meaning: Whatever the best person does, others follow. Whatever standard they set, the world copies.

hi.intro: श्रीकृष्ण आगे बताते हैं कि अर्जुन को कर्म क्यों करना चाहिए, क्योंकि पूरी दुनिया की नज़र उन पर टिकी है।
hi.meaning: श्रेष्ठ मनुष्य जो-जो आचरण करता है, दूसरे लोग भी वैसा ही आचरण करते हैं। वह जिस बात को प्रमाण मान लेता है, लोग उसी के अनुसार चलते हैं।
hi.notice: श्रेष्ठ जैसा आचरण करता है, लोग वैसा ही करते हैं
hi.next: श्रीकृष्ण आगे पूछते हैं कि यदि आप श्रेष्ठ होकर भी कर्म छोड़ दें, तो पूरी दुनिया का नेतृत्व कैसे होगा।

en.intro: Krishna continues by explaining why Arjuna must act, reminding him that his conduct is watched by the world.
